decided: When a record of an earlier review of the program cannot be read, orbit says it cannot tell whether the program is done and asks the user nothing, instead of passing over that record.
alternatives: pass over a record that cannot be read and look at the earlier reviews instead
treat the program as not done without saying why
why: Passing over a damaged record could let an older review count as the program's closing review, so a signature would name the wrong review; saying what failed lets the user fix it.
